title: Variational Quantum Algorithm for Constrained Combinatorial Optimization Problems
summary: While variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) have demonstrated considerable success in unconstrained optimization, their application to constrained combinatorial problems face a trade-off. Penalty-based methods, despite their circuit simplicity, suffer from a fundamental limitation: inefficient sampling in vast infeasible regions. This often results in suboptimal solutions that violate constraints and impede convergence to high-quality results.
